Static Exports - Supported Features
text_content: The core of Next.js has been designed to support static exports.

title: Static Exports - Server Components
text_content:
When you run `` to generate a static export, Server Components consumed inside the `` directory will run during the build, similar to traditional static-site generation.
The resulting component will be rendered into static HTML for the initial page load and a static payload for client navigation between routes. No changes are required for your Server Components when using the static export, unless they consume [#unsupported-features](#unsupported-features).
